title: iPad Signature Capture
lede: Staff at a media day open a team roster on the iPad, find whoever walks up, and capture an Apple Pencil signature in the same layout they know from the web.

sections.heading: New screens (after only)
sections.note: These screens did not exist in the iOS app before, so there is no baseline to pair. Captured by `SignatureScreenshotUITests` on a dedicated iPad Air 13-inch (M4) simulator, iOS 27.0, light appearance, fixture scenarios `signature-collections`, `signature-roster`, `signature-capture` (fictional names; synthetic ink from the web's pen-preview sample). Landscape frames were rotated upright from the native-portrait framebuffer.

shots.title: Collections
shots.cap: Web roster cards: season, Open badge, Complete x/y with progress, staff count, % ready, Open roster.

shots.title: Roster
shots.cap: Readiness header, search by name/number/title, group filter, collapsible groups with signed counts, jersey circles, green signed rows with saved-signature previews, red Capture for players and neutral Capture for staff.

shots.title: Capture
shots.cap: Header card (Roster / signer / status), the Undo · Redo · Clear · Replay bar above a dashed canvas, then Cancel and Save signature.

shots.title: Portrait
shots.cap: iPadOS will not let a multitasking app force rotation, so portrait shows a rotate prompt; ink drawn so far is kept.

changes.h: Capture moves from Safari to the app
changes.was: Pencil samples reached the page through Safari's coalesced Pointer Events; the 2026-27 captures recorded about half of them twice.
changes.now: UIKit coalesced touches deliver each Pencil sample once with its timestamp; predicted touches only hide latency and are never saved. Repeated runs are still dropped, with the web's rule.

changes.was: Small icon buttons, and Clear could only be undone through a separate state.
changes.now: Large Undo, Redo, Clear, and Replay sit together above the canvas. Undo restores a Clear. Pencil double-tap or squeeze and Command-Z also undo.

changes.was: No way to see the signature drawn back.
changes.now: Replay redraws the unsaved strokes at the signer's real Pencil pace, with pen lifts capped at half a second.

verification: 15 XCTest cases (recorder, retry rule, history, replay, roster filtering): TEST SUCCEEDED on the iPad simulator.
SignatureScreenshotUITests (landscape screens and portrait prompt): TEST SUCCEEDED.
Wisconsin scheme builds for iPad Air 13 and iPhone 18 Pro Max simulators (BUILD SUCCEEDED, no new warnings).
All 124 iOS source-contract test files and `tests/signature-capture.test.ts` pass; iOS drift check clean; audit inventory has no gaps.
Not verified: a real Apple Pencil (palm rejection, double-tap/squeeze, 240 Hz sampling), an authenticated save against a server, and saved-preview loading from the private artifact route.
notes: Fixture captures prove layout only. The acceptance gate is a physical iPad + Pencil save; see `docs/IOS_DEVICE_WALKTHROUGH.md`.
Unsaved ink lives in memory only; leaving capture or the app being killed loses it (the web keeps device-local drafts).
Replaying a saved signature needs pen timing stored on the server (plan slice 2).
